name: Croatia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, white and blue, with the coat of arms in the centre: a red-and-white checkerboard shield topped by a crown of five small historical shields.
flag.symbolism: Red, white and blue are pan-Slavic colours; the checkerboard is Croatia's traditional arms, and the five crown shields represent historic regions including Dubrovnik, Dalmatia, Istria and Slavonia.

hook: Red-white-blue with a red-and-white chessboard shield in the middle: Croatia plays chess, while the Netherlands is plain and Serbia runs red-blue-white.
trivia: The checkerboard shield, called the šahovnica, has been a Croatian symbol since at least the 15th century.
The necktie takes its name, 'cravat', from the scarves worn by Croatian soldiers in 17th-century France.
